svg.title: Known-best packing of 180 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=180 construction, never the source witness: Evan Daniel's regularizer's view of it, its contacts re-solved exactly at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete b637e6c rational centre/half-angle certificates in Evan Daniel's format, centres in [0, S]^2, read exactly from the retained source files, each held to the source's own Witness/v2 corner file of the same packing. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=180 regularized: side ~ 13.9156185 (certified upper bound)
